create_BaseOptions: create a BaseOptions instance to configure argparse arguments for audio-visual experiments
initialize_BaseOptions: initialize BaseOptions to add command-line arguments for dataset path, GPU IDs, batch size, and audio parameters
parse_BaseOptions: parse BaseOptions to process CLI arguments, configure GPU devices, print options, and save them to disk
configure_gpu_ids: configure gpu_ids from comma-separated string to integer list and set the primary CUDA device
save_options_to_disk: save parsed argparse options to opt.txt file in the experiment checkpoint directory
